answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a public randomness beacon. Since the word is unknown until the epoch opens, sybils cannot precompute template identities; every fake agent must solve a fresh challenge every round, paying compute and stake each time. Honest agents embed the challenge naturally: an agent anchors its report to the word ocean, describes a routing choice as a falcon, or hashes a canyon phrase into its attestation, all peer-verifiable. Fakes must keep paying continuously while honest agents answer once as a byproduct of working.
